owner.description: The person taking care of the dog

description:
Dear Vet,

I’d like to introduce you to my companion, Buddy, a five‑year‑old Labrador. He’s a friendly and active dog who loves his daily walks and playtime at the park. As his primary caretaker, I (Alice Johnson) make sure he stays up to date on his vaccinations and receives regular exercise and grooming.

If you need any additional information regarding Buddy’s health history or upcoming appointments, please let me know. Thank you for your continued care and support.
